videos.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender

videos.overview: Aang enters Omashu so he can learn Earthbending from King Bumi, but the city is in the hands of the Fire Nation!

videos.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
videos.overview: When the kids end up in a mysterious and strange swamp, their fears are exposed. And Aang learns about being "connected to the Earth" from an unlikely teacher.

videos.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
videos.overview: Aang must clear up a wave of anti-Avatar sentiment and atone for something he did in the past.

videos.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
videos.overview: Aang discovers a possible Earthbending mentor at an underground tournament.

videos.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
videos.overview: Traveling without Uncle now, Zuko wanders alone into an Earth Kingdom town where he bonds with a local boy. Meanwhile, Zuko is haunted by memories of his own youth.

videos.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
videos.overview: As the kids are pursued relentlessly by a mysterious machine, their exhaustion puts them at each other's throats.

videos.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
videos.overview: When Aang struggles with a block while trying to learn Earthbending from Toph, he wonders if the problem is with him or his teacher.

videos.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
videos.overview: A professor leads the kids to a spirit library in the middle of the desert, where Sokka hopes to discover powerful secrets to use against the Fire Nation.

videos.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
videos.overview: Aang searches for Appa, while Katara struggles to keep everyone together so they can survive in the vast desert.

videos.overview: When the kids are prevented from taking the "easy way" into Ba Sing Se, they must escort a family of refugees there the hard way -- through the deadly Serpent's Pass.

videos.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
videos.overview: Aang discovers a colossal Fire Nation invention heading for Ba Sing Se, and the kids must stop it before it destroys the great wall that protects the city from invasion.

videos.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
videos.overview: Aang and the kids finally arrive in Ba Sing Se to see the Earth King, only to find mysterious forces within the city conspiring to stop them.

videos.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
videos.overview: A series of short stories, highlighting different characters and their individual adventures in the city.

videos.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
videos.overview: In this special episode, we go back in time to the moment Appa was stolen.

videos.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
videos.overview: While searching for Appa, the kids run into Jet, but are torn about whether to trust him or not. Meanwhile, Zuko also hunts for Appa.

videos.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
videos.overview: The kids battle Long Feng the Dai Li when they attempt to show the Earth King the vast conspiracy taking place in his city.

videos.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
videos.overview: A guru at the Eastern Air Temple helps Aang take the next step in his Avatar journey.

videos.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
videos.overview: Everyone races against time to stop Azula's sinister conquest of Ba Sing Se.

videos.overview: When Po is asked to bring a young princess to the King of the Qidan to make a peace offering, they learn that an agreement between the two kingdoms will come at a cost.

videos.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
videos.overview: When Po learns a kung fu move that can erase someone's short-term memory, he takes it too far.

videos.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
videos.overview: When a rhino comes to the Valley of Peace seeking to destroy the Dragon Warrior, Po tries to befriend him before he discovers Po's true identity.

videos.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
videos.overview: After Po unleashes an "impossible move," he's told that the most powerful fighter in the Valley of Peace always turns evil, and that's him!

videos.overview: After Po disobeys Shifu's orders, the Hierarchy of the Sacred Onyx Council replaces Shifu with a new master who banishes the Furious Five and plans to destroy Shifu.

videos.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
videos.overview: When Mantis returns to his hometown claiming to be the Dragon Warrior to impress his ex-fiancé, Po pretends to be his sidekick who doesn't know kung fu.

videos.overview: Shifu tells the citizens of the Valley of Peace that whoever can defeat Po before sunset will become the new Dragon Warrior. When Hundun hears of the challenge, he returns to the village to claim the title.

videos.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
videos.overview: After Po gets trapped in a hole, Fung helps him out and is owed a favor. Will it be a costly one?

videos.overview: To impress his fan club, Po releases the Mongolian Fist Demon. Now he has to figure out how to defeat the Demon and save the village and his fans!

videos.overview: Po disobeys Shifu's orders and looks into the Mystical Mirror of Yin and Yang, creating two versions of himself: one good and one evil!

videos.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness

videos.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
videos.overview: Po discovers his dad, Mr. Ping, is dating Scorpion, but he has trouble trusting his former enemy who claims to no longer be evil.

videos.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
videos.overview: Po realizes he must select a trophy for the Hall of Heroes, but instead finds himself helping a young villager retrieve a rabbit doll that is much more important than it looks.
